title: RecordingStarted
description: Emitted by the recording-orchestrator when a recording session is created and transitioned from pending to recording. Subscribers include the engagement-graph (start replay window), the search-index-cursor (track new content), and the SCORM packager (init session record).

hash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the event payload (chain link).

prev_hash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the previous event in the chain.
